name: html-linked-fill-image-percentage-height-chain
description: Two identical cards whose author CSS fills a fixed-height media box with an absolutely positioned `width:100%;height:100%` image. One card is wrapped in a link, the other is not. core/image serializes a linked image as ``, so the linked card gains an injected, inline-level, auto-height between the figure that carries the container height and the whose authored percentage height has to resolve against it. Without the link being sized, that percentage resolves against an auto-height box and the image falls back to its intrinsic ratio, rendering short with a gap below it, while the byte-identical unlinked card is correct. The figure-height carrier therefore restates the fill on the injected link, and the projected author rule that bridges the source image's box onto the generated is projected through the link as well so object-fit/object-position/border-radius still reach it. The unlinked card must keep exactly the markup and carrier rule it had before: no link rule is emitted for an image no source ancestor links. The bridge's `object-fit`/`object-position`/`border-radius` are all `inherit`, and none of the three is an inherited property, so for a linked image they would read the generated anchor's initial values instead of the figure's: the anchor relays them so the bridge lands the same either way.

source_reference.notes: Regression coverage for a card grid whose linked cover photos rendered at their intrinsic aspect ratio instead of filling the card's fixed-height media box.
